ops.title: Define exact whole-module remote lint execution without weakening typechecks
ops.description: Coordinator owner: /root. Confirmed retained Go84888 exports whole cc-context module during commit-time lint; --new-from-rev filters issues after analysis and never hides typecheck errors. Existing monorepo remote-Go list/export routing is intentionally local and provides no full lint/autofix transport for this outside checkout. Pin repair task7f6cbc is independent and does not promise lower or zeroIO. Next executable step: bounded source design against existing Mac builder transport for exact dirty/untracked source+HEAD+WASM snapshot, repo Go/linter/CGO/SDK/env parity, fullmodule diagnostics and guarded return of only real fixes. No local fallback, globalroute/CGO change or changed-package filtering. Evidence FE/ccx-prek-golangci-export-source-diagnosis.json SHA8d4dabc6. Root disposition precedes implementation/remote execution.

ops.text: Root accepts a concrete snapshot/toolchain/diagnostics/autofix-return contract preserving full-module typecheck and source ownership.
Existing transport capability and remaining required code/test scope are source-bound; no unsafe remote Export-path shortcut or silent local fallback.
